body:
Real investigation found levels are compiled C code today (levels/*.c + physics.h's hardcoded stage geometry arrays) -- zero data-driven format/loader exists, a real blocking Phase 0. Also found zero IDUNA login integration, zero web presence, zero embedded-browser capability anywhere in this repo. 5-phase plan scoped in docs/BP_LEVEL_EDITOR_NORTHSTAR.md, registered as golden doc BP-LEVEL-EDITOR-NORTH. Cards stay open pending founder decisions on login architecture (native vs web-token) and map-registry hosting.

⚓ ☃
title: BPLE-12441/BPLE-13331: online level editor scoped (Principle 19), not built -- real blocking Phase 0 found
